meta.name: Inspector Avinash 1080p
meta.description:
Set in 1998 UP, this is the story of a dynamic cop leading a Special Task Force which becomes instrumental in eliminating a dreaded weapons cartel.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 18 May 2023 · India · Language: Hindi · 45 min
Studio: Jio Studios, Gold Mountain Pictures · Network: JioCinema, JioHotstar

Not complete. On your server: S1 7/8 (missing E8) | S2 10/10

videos.title: The dynamic policeman, Avinash
videos.overview: Avinash Mishra infiltrates the arms trafficking underworld, discovering a plot to target Ayodhya with RDX. Can he stop the attack and save the sacred site?

videos.title: Avinash's inspiring quest
videos.overview: Super cop Avinash Mishra faces a deadly weapon cartel. Can he overcome the challenges and bring them down?

videos.title: Avinash faces a disaster
videos.overview: Avinash's relentless interrogation of Bhati ends tragically, with Bhati dying in custody.  Avinash now faces the consequences of his actions.

videos.title: Avinash encounters Rafiq
videos.overview: Avinash Mishra tracks down Rafiq Khazi at a wedding. Can he and his team capture him and uncover the truth?

videos.title: A huge responsibility for Avinash
videos.overview: Inspector Avinash fights to lower crime, but a wealthy businessman's son is kidnapped. Can he catch the culprits before it's too late?

videos.title: Avinash gets ambushed
videos.overview: Avinash and his team close in on a gang's hideout. But the criminals spot them, leading to a deadly shootout. Will Avinash prevail?

videos.title: Avinash receives a tip
videos.overview: Avinash tracks Bablu Pandey, only to learn from Pinky that Azimuddin Gulam Sheikh orchestrated the child's shooting. Will Avinash believe Pinky?

videos.title: Shadyantra
videos.overview: Crucial intel about Devi leads Avinash to Nepal. Chaos erupts in Varun's school when a boy is found dead. Meanwhile, Sheikh saves an actress from trouble, who ends up meeting Veer.

videos.title: Vyavastha
videos.overview: Nandlal shakes up the Special Task Force with strict discipline. Varun's name surfaces in his school's case, fuelling conflict. New alliances begin to form in the shadows.

videos.title: Lakshman Rekha
videos.overview: Avinash's work affects his home life when Poonam has a traumatic experience. Meanwhile, Avinash finds out about Gujjar, Devi, Sheikh, their new ally, and their big plan.

videos.title: Asura Bhaag I
videos.overview: Avinash leads his team into Chambal's dangerous ravines chasing the elusive Abhay Gujjar. Meanwhile, Suman finds a clue at a medical college that may solve a long-standing mystery.

videos.title: Asura Bhaag II
videos.overview: Kabir sets the stage for Avinash to invade Gujjar's lair in the Badlands. Realising that the deal with Sheikh won't be fulfilled, the Naxal troop tries to intimidate him.

videos.title: Vishwasghaat
videos.overview: Baljeet and Suman's divorce shocks all, and a courtroom clash sparks humiliation. Avinash cracks his son Varun's case. A wedding celebration turns tense with unexpected trouble.

videos.title: Maharathi
videos.overview: Amidst allegations of corruption, Laxmikant takes an extreme step. Suman makes a shocking discovery about the lab assistant Sharda Awasthi, and she calls Baljeet for help.

videos.title: Yudh Viram
videos.overview: Investigation on Sharda answers a lot of unsolved mysteries and sheds light on Sheikh's past. Meanwhile, Sheikh sends Imran to kill Avinash.

videos.title: Takhta Palat
videos.overview: The suspended STF team decides to fight back and go after Mahaveer. Ahalawat proves his worth and gives Gaya Prasad a fighting chance in court.

videos.title: Mahabharat
videos.overview: A crucial witness jeopardises the STF team's case, but a new friend welcomes Avinash. Devi cleans house to safeguard Sheikh, but another battle awaits the supercop.
